Standing sound waves: closed vs open organ pipes – displacement s(x) and pressure ΔP(x)
Closed pipe (one end closed): L = (2n-1)λ/4, only odd harmonics Closed end: s=0 (node), ΔP antinode. Open end: s antinode, ΔP=0
n=1, f1=v/4L
n=2, f3=3v/4L (2nd allowed is 3rd harmonic)
Open pipe (both ends open): L = nλ/2, all harmonics f_n = n v/2L
n=1, f1=v/2L, λ=2L
n=2, f2=v/L
Displacement node ↔ Pressure antinode; Displacement antinode ↔ Pressure node Proof: ΔP = -B ∂s/∂x, max slope at s=0 → pressure extremum. Valid for small amplitudes, rigid walls
<line x1="400" y1="300" x2="400" y2="330" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width:1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/> <line x1="420" y1="300" x2="420" y2="330" stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width:1"/> e≈0.6r Effective length L_eff = L+e (closed), L+2e (open). Rayleigh correction. Valid for r≪λ, r≪L
